senses.gloss:
पौलस्त्य पौलस्त्य, अस्, -स्ती, अम्, relating to
or descended from Pulasti or Pulastya; (अस्), m. a
patronymic from Pulasti or Pulastya; an epithet of
Kuvera; of Rāvaṇa; of Vibhīṣaṇa; of the moon;
N. of an astronomer; (आस्), m. pl. an epithet of the
brothers of Dur-yodhana; (पौलस्ती), f. a patro-
nymic of Śūrpa-ṇakhā the sister of Rāvaṇa.

पौलि पौलि, इस्, ई, m. f. grain half dressed
or scorched or fried with ghee and made into a
sort of cake.

पौलिका, f. a kind of cake (= पौलि; perhaps
an error for पोलिका).

पौलिश पौलिश, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुलिश), de-
rived from or composed by Puliśa.
—पौलिश-सिद्-
धान्त, अस्, m., N. of an astronomical work.

पौलुषि पौलुषि, इस्, m. (fr. पुलुष), Ved.
a patronymic of Satya-yajña.

पौलोम पौलोम, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to or
treating of Pulomā, an epithet of Adhyāyas 4-12 of
the Ādi-parva of the Mahā-bhārata; relating to
Puloman or Pulomā or Paulomī; descended from
Puloman or Pulomā; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a class of
demons; (ई), f. the daughter of Puloman, an epithet
of the wife of Indra; (अस्), m. an epithet of Indra;
a Muni.
—पौलोमी-मङ्गल, अस्, आ, अम्, as for-
tunate or happy as Paulomī.
—पौलोमी-सम्भव,
अस्, m. born from Paulomī, son of Paulomī (an
epithet of Jayanta, q. v.).

पौल्कस पौल्कस, अस्, m., Ved. (= पुल्कस,
said to be) the son of a Niṣāda or of a Śūdra
father and of a Kṣatriyā mother.
